name: dotnet-agents
description: Custom .NET development agents for GitHub Copilot and Claude Code: an orchestrator and eight specialists take a BA package through .NET adaptation, module design, a build loop (code, review, test, fix), security and documentation to three approval gates and the developer's Git decision. A deterministic engine (MCP server) owns the rules, the gates and the checks; hooks enforce scope, secrets and Git rules in agent projects.
